newsitem.title: USA: Surfer survives shark attack off Florida coast.
newsitem.headline: Surfer survives shark attack off Florida coast.

text.p: A shark chomped down on a surfer's foot off the south Florida coast but the victim managed to struggle free, scarred but intact.
Adam Urban, 26, was surfing Monday afternoon near Jupiter Island when the shark attacked.
"It happened so fast," he told the Sun-Sentinel newspaper from his hospital bed. "I looked down and my toes were flopping down because the tendons were cut and blood was just pouring out."

Dr. Gary McClain, who operated on Urban's leg at the Jupiter Medical Centre, said: "It was interesting because you could tell the patient's whole foot had been in the shark's mouth. There were teeth marks on both the top and the bottom of the foot."
Urban vowed he would go back in the water.
It was the 13th shark attack in Florida this year and the Palm Beach area was particularly vulnerable, shark expert George Burgess said in Wednesday's Sun-Sentinel.
